decision: After publishing this smoke, assess a separately registered eight-game frozen economic screening with two new seeds, one new fixed opponent and both seats, comparing the sealed model with the frozen task teacher.
basis: The model loaded, scored tasks and changed official requests in both seat checks; this resolves the immediate integration question but the one-seed economics cannot establish strength. The previous offline fertilizer recall and this smoke do not identify a specific fix.
constraints: Preserve the candidate checkpoint, crop controller, default Bot, engine and all historical evidence; do not retrain or tune on this panel. Freeze seeds, absolute and relative metrics, exploratory stop thresholds, output privacy, replay budget and no-retry rules before execution.
interpretation: Two seed clusters support only an exploratory screen for preset large declines, not proof of improvement or statistical significance. The proposed -1000 seed-average and -2000 seat limits are diagnostic guardrails, not guarantees.
